question: How do I control the URLs for pages and sections? If I define the URL in two places, which one wins? Do parent section URLs affect the URLs of pages inside them?
ground_truth: You can control URL slugs at two levels: 1) Set the `slug` property in the `navigation` object in your docs.yml file for sections or pages, and 2) Override a page's slug in the frontmatter of the markdown file itself using the `slug` property. If you set slugs in both places for the same page, the frontmatter slug takes precedence over the docs.yml configuration, giving you page-level override capability. For sections, when you set a section slug (like `slug: start` for 'Get Started'), it affects the URL path - child pages inherit the section's slug as part of their path (e.g., a page in the 'Get Started' section would be at `/start/page-name`). However, a page can use a frontmatter slug to completely override its URL path, breaking out of the section hierarchy if needed (so you could have a page at `/start-up` even if it's in a different section).

metadata.cited_context:
To modify the slug used for a page or section, you can set the `slug` within the `navigation` object. 

```yaml {{3, 6}}
navigation:
  - section: Get Started
    slug: start
    contents: 
      - page: Welcome 
        slug: intro
        path: ./docs/pages/welcome.mdx
```

In the example above, the **Welcome** page would be hosted at `plantstore.docs.buildwithfern.com/start/intro`. 

#### Override a page's slug
You can set the exact slug of a page within its frontmatter. [You can read more about the frontmatter configuration here](/learn/docs/configuration/page-level-settings#slug). 

```yaml title="docs.yml"
navigation:
  - section: Get Started
    slug: start
    contents: 
      - page: Quick Start 
        path: ./docs/pages/quick-start.mdx
```

You can set the slug in the frontmatter of `./docs/pages/quick-start.mdx` to `start-up`:

```markdown title="quick-start.mdx" {{2}}
---
slug: start-up
---
```

The page then becomes available at `plantstore.docs.buildwithfern.com/start-up`.
